lines.trans: Let's agree right away that nothing happened.
We just fell asleep and just woke up.
You came to me with a bottle and got me drunk.
And where is my shirt right now?
You know where my clothes are.
Even a button on the shirt was torn off.
Listen, I honestly do not remember anything.
Yeah, I do not remember either.
How did we get so wasted from one bottle?
We could not have from just one.
But from three, easily.
Where did we get hold of them?
They do not sell alcohol at night.
